text:
In Termux, one command installs Debian with the XFCE desktop:

```bash
andronix install debian --de xfce
```

When it finishes, open the desktop full screen in Termux:X11:

```bash
andronix desktop debian
```

1. Keep Termux open while it installs.
2. If the install stops halfway, run the same install command again. It picks up where it stopped.

Sources: [The andronix command](https://docs.andronix.app/reference/andronix-command) and [Install problems](https://docs.andronix.app/termux/install-problems).

Yes. To open the desktop again later, run the same command:

```bash
andronix desktop debian
```
